purpose: AT-01 audit: every declared agent-tool capability ID mapped to its exact implementation, contract and owner. An enabled:true YAML flag is a declaration, never authenticated execution authority.

datacloud.media.artifacts.note: Data Cloud read-model descriptor, not an executable Media tool; no handler and no execution authority

guards.noDuplicateRegistry: AudioVideoToolHandlerFactory is the single handler registry; capability YAMLs declare, the factory dispatches
guards.enabledIsNotAuthority: an enabled:true flag grants no execution authority — authorization runs through the Tools/Action Plane pipeline per request
guards.unknownIdFailsClosed: factory.create throws on any toolId outside the registry
